info.name: Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek (DDB) API
info.description:
German Digital Library API v2 (52 operations from the official OpenAPI) incl. the German Newspaper Portal full-text index. Search endpoints worked without a key at build time; user/favourites endpoints need a bearer token from your DDB account (My DDB → API key).

OpenAPI: https://api.deutsche-digitale-bibliothek.de/2/q/openapi · Docs: https://labs.deutsche-digitale-bibliothek.de/app/ddbapi/

item.name: ★ Research · Banat / Hungary

request.description: Solr search across all DDB objects. Use Solr syntax.
German Newspaper Portal full text — includes German-language Banat/Hungarian papers. 64 hits for Beodra at time of building.
